Live close-accounting behaviour changes: a strategy position closed outside the engine's exit orders is recorded as an external_close reconciliation artifact (exact for the platform close routes; approximate after 15 min for closes with no DB row) and its entry gate is released; a close still pending 30 min after it was observed raises one CRITICAL per episode.

Known limit: the engine's own (system) lot of an externally closed lifetime stays open in the lot ledger, so the next entry in that symbol cannot release its pending identity through the open-position check (EXE-03 CRITICAL after 30 min, symbol pending-entry gated) until owner-agnostic lot matching or a lot repair lands.

A forward external_close artifact has a price source other than db_position_fills, so every later daily evidence report flags unqualified_price_source until the next activation (as for orphan artifacts).
